verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships an official CLI that manages flags, segments, projects and environments from the terminal, with raw API access and a repo-checkable config file. Its Admin API covers everything the dashboard can do, and its official MCP server is documented as running "fully automated in a CI/CD pipeline", which together give a clear headless and CI path. Missing for 10: CI-specific CLI docs (non-interactive auth/token handling, exit codes, pipeline examples), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.
The CLI covers flags, segments, features, organisations, projects, environments, SDK-style flag evaluation, and raw API access.
Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
